# Kristina Moore

Kristina Moore is the current Deputy of [District 1](https://flow.je/elections/district-1) and was first elected to the States of Jersey in 2011.

Kristina Moore has participated in 4 elections since 2002:

- [**2011 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/kristina-moore#e15)

  Elected as Deputy of St Peter with 66.2% of the vote.

  - [2011 Full Manifesto](https://web.archive.org/web/20110928162413/http://www.channel103.com:80/election/?page_id=103)
- [**2014 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/kristina-moore#e20)

  Elected as Deputy of St Peter with 85.5% of the vote.

  - [2014 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2014/kristina-moore-2/)
  - [2014 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ROcSEFKhOS0)
- [**2018 Senators Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/kristina-moore#e41)

  Elected as Senator with 56.5% of the ballot.

  - [2018 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2018/kristina-moore-3/)
  - [2018 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4qXs75AA0Tk)
  - [2018 Full Manifesto](https://web.archive.org/web/20201121071236/https://moore4jersey.squarespace.com/manifesto/)
  - [2018 Bailiwick Express Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KlHGzfA_Swo)
  - [2018 ITV Video](http://www.itv.com/news/channel/2018-04-10/jsy2018-kristinamoore/)
- [**2022 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/kristina-moore#e48)

  Elected as Deputy of District 1 with 73.8% of the ballot.

  - [2022 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2022/kristina-moore/)
  - [2022 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rKDadWGUUQ0)
  - [2022 Full Manifesto](https://moore4jersey.squarespace.com/manifesto)
  - [2022 SCOOP Food Security Questionnaire](https://drive.google.com/uc?export=view&id=1kI5ESEJ4byHHwSp76kLGeBkayQSQynP9#page=11)

## Election History

### 2011 Deputies Election

Election for the role of Deputy of [St Peter](https://flow.je/elections/st-peter) (1 seat), 7th September 2011.

**Kristina Moore was elected as Deputy of St Peter in 2011**.

|  | Name | Party | Votes |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **Kristina Moore** |  | 1,169 | 66.2% |
| 2 | [Wayne Le Marquand](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/wayne-le-marquand) |  | 589 | 33.4% |

1,766 votes (inc. 8 spoilt papers)

3,529 registered voters

= 50% turnout
